scenarios.task: Repoint weathered sandstone balustrade on the Piazzale Michelangelo terrace overlooking the Arno.
hazards: fall from terrace edge (unprotected drop to hillside)
hand injury from chisel or grinder kickback
heat stress in Mediterranean summer sun
ppe: safety harness with anchor to guardrail system
hard hat, eye protection, hi-vis vest
steps: Set up exclusion zone and dust containment barriers
Install fall-protection anchors and tie off before edge work
Rake out deteriorated mortar without damaging stone
Mix lime mortar matched to historic specification
Repoint joints, tool and cure per supervisor direction
Clean tools and dispose of silica-contaminated waste properly

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off while within 2 m of unprotected edge
wet-cutting or vacuum extraction used on all silica-generating tasks
mortar joint profile and lime mix match spec sheet
no debris or tools left within fall zone at task end

scenarios.task: Pull and terminate new lighting branch circuit for the Progress Observatory displays in the terrace loggia.
hazards: working at height on rolling scaffold
conductor damage from pulls through old conduit
ppe: arc-rated face shield and FR clothing
steps: Obtain lockout/tagout permit and apply personal locks
Verify de-energization with meter, test-meter-test
Pull THHN conductors through existing conduit with fish tape
Terminate at panel breaker and observatory fixture boxes
Ground and bond per drawings, torque lugs to spec
Remove locks, energize, and verify with meter

rubric.pass_if: personal lock applied and zero-energy verified before any conductor handling
breaker sizing, grounding and bonding match print
no conductor damaged; no one in pinch points during pull
circuit tested live under supervision with correct readings

scenarios.robot_role: Carries cable reels and tools up terrace stairs and inspects conduit runs with camera, keeping apprentice out of unnecessary trips on wet marble steps.

scenarios.task: Replace storm-water pump in the piazza drainage vault that handles Arno hillside runoff.
steps: Complete confined-space permit and atmospheric test
Ventilate vault and post attendant at entry point
Isolate, lock out pump power and valve feeds
Disconnect flanges, rig and hoist old pump out
Set new pump, reconnect flanges and check torque
Restore power, test-run, check flow and leaks

rubric.pass_if: confined space permit, attendant and gas log completed before entry
all energy sources locked out and verified
pump hoisted with rated slings and tag lines, no hands under load
pump runs and draws to spec without leaks

scenarios.robot_role: Tows the pump assembly to the vault and lowers gas sensors ahead of human entry to pre-check atmosphere.

scenarios.task: Rig and signal a crane pick of glass panels for the Proposal Forum skylight on the crowded piazza terrace.
hazards: wind load on large glass panels
steps: Complete lift plan and confirm crane inspection tag
Barricade swing radius and reroute pedestrian traffic
Inspect spreader bar, vacuum cups and slings
Rig panels, tag lines on, signal trial lift 150 mm
Direct set onto skylight curb with slow hand signals
Land, unhitch and inspect panels for damage

rubric.pass_if: all rigging visually inspected and rated for panel weight before pick
standard hand signals used and only one designated signal person
barricades prevent any pedestrian exposure under load
pick halted if sustained wind exceeds lift-plan limit

scenarios.task: Mount ballasted solar modules on canopy racking powering the Research Synthesis Lab kiosks on the terrace roof deck.
hazards: DC arc-flash and shock from series strings
heat stress and sunburn on exposed deck
steps: Verify ballast layout and roof load limits with drawings
Stage modules with tethered tools only
Assemble racking and torque clamps to spec
Connect string wiring MC4s with breakers open
Verify polarity and insulation resistance before combiner close
Ground arrays and label per print

rubric.pass_if: strings kept open and polarity verified before energization
tether points and toe boards used near roof edge
all tools tethered; exclusion zone below maintained
torque marks present on all clamps and ground lugs

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and positions modules on racking while apprentice torques connections, reducing repetitive lifts.

scenarios.task: Build tube-and-clamp scaffold in front of the Charter Hall loggia arches for façade maintenance.
hazards: dropped clamps on public terrace below
overhead power line near arch lighting
steps: Check scaffold plan, load rating and ground condition
Barricade footprint and post drop-zone signs
Erect base plates, standards and ledgers, level each lift
Install guardrails and toe boards before climbing to work
Tag scaffold complete after competent-person inspection
Strike scaffold in reverse order, lowering clamps by hand line

rubric.pass_if: all standards plumb, base plates sound, couplers tight
harness worn once lift height exceeds 3 m until guardrails complete
barricades and signage maintained throughout
scaffold used only after competent-person tag

scenarios.robot_role: Carries clamps and boards up completed lifts and performs final plumb check with onboard sensors before tagging.

scenarios.task: Install a Level 2 EV charger for the maintenance cart fleet at the Operations Deck service yard.
steps: Confirm circuit sizing, grounding electrode and GFCI protection per print
Lock out supply breaker before rough-in
Mount pedestal and pull conductors in liquid-tight conduit
Terminate charger, torque and photograph connections
Megger test circuit and check ground-fault trip
Energize and perform test charge cycle

rubric.pass_if: supply locked out and verified before rough-in
RCD/GFCI and grounding verified per manufacturer and code
insulation resistance and trip test pass before energization
cones or flagging protect work area from carts

scenarios.task: Remove lead-based paint from historic iron railings before repainting Progress Observatory perimeter.
ppe: disposable coveralls with hood and tape
steps: Set up containment with plastic sheeting and negative air
Wet-scrape or use stripper per SDS, no dry sanding
Bag and label lead waste for licensed disposal
Decontaminate tools, suit removal in sequence
Post clearance wipe test before primer application
Apply primer and finish coats with ventilation

rubric.pass_if: no visible dust or debris outside containment
no dry abrasive methods used
PPE doffing and hygiene steps performed in order
all waste labeled and manifested per supervisor

scenarios.robot_role: Performs wet-scraping on highest railing sections under operator control, keeping the apprentice off ladder work in the containment zone.
